action: Repaired both SureForms forms: sender authentication, field type, spam protection, labels and copy

forms.3091: Newsletter, footer-widget-4, appears on every page

findings.verdict: partly wrong, and wrong about the visible symptom
findings.detail: The error text a reviewer sees in the page source sits inside a hidden element and is not shown to visitors. The form submits. The real defect was invisible: the notification's From address.

findings.issue: Notification sent as {admin_email}, a gmail.com address, from a Hostinger server
findings.detail: lookdog.club publishes v=spf1 include:_spf.mail.hostinger.com ~all. Nothing authorises that server to send as gmail.com, so every notification failed SPF alignment for the From domain and was liable to be filtered.
findings.fix: from_email is now noreply@lookdog.club, inside the domain's own SPF record

findings.issue: Default notification put {admin_email} in to, cc and bcc
findings.fix: cc and bcc cleared; one copy per submission

findings.issue: Reply-To was {admin_email}, so replying to a subscriber notification emailed yourself
findings.fix: Reply-To is now the submitter: {form:email} on 3091, {form:srfm-email} on 3086

findings.issue: Newsletter field was wp:srfm/input, a plain text box
findings.detail: No email validation, no type="email", no email keyboard on mobile

findings.issue: No spam protection (_srfm_form_recaptcha = none on both forms)
findings.fix: Enabled the global honeypot via srfm_security_settings_options['srfm_honeypot']. Needs no API keys. SureForms rejects a submission that fills the hidden field or strips it.

findings.detail: The field's only name was a placeholder, which disappears the moment anyone types and is not reliably announced by screen readers
findings.fix: Turned off on both forms; real labels now render

copy.footer_heading: Stay Updated -> One email per guide
copy.footer_body: Get new product ideas and useful dog-accessory guides. -> We write a long buying guide every few weeks and send a note when one goes up. That is all this list is for - no daily deals, and your address goes nowhere else.
copy.confirmation: Generic 'We'll review your details and get back to you soon' replaced with what the list actually does

verification.notification_path: Called Form_Submit::send_email() with wp_mail short-circuited via pre_wp_mail. Captured: To motilevi@gmail.com, Subject 'New newsletter subscriber: test-subscriber@example.com', From 'LookDog <noreply@lookdog.club>', Reply-To the submitter, body carries the address.
verification.live_markup: Homepage form renders type="email", a real <label>, the honeypot field and the Subscribe button. Contact page renders 4 labels plus the footer form's.
verification.real_send: One test email sent to the admin address; wp_mail returned true with no wp_mail_failed error. CONFIRMED BY THE RECIPIENT the same day: it arrived at the owner's Gmail. That closes the loop the SPF change was made to fix - both forms deliver.
verification.entries_table: 1 row, a July 2026 submission to form 969 (a starter-site demo form that no longer exists). No real subscriber data existed to lose.
